data.gender_notes: Verna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word vera, meaning true or authentic. In Christian tradition, Verna is associated with faith and authentic spirituality. The name Verna carries the meaning “True, authentic” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Verna usually hope their child will grow to embody true, authentic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Verna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “True, authentic.”

in_hebrew.name: ורנה
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור איטלקי, חג השלמה, חידוש, חסות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ורנה היא שם נשים נדיר, שמקורו באיטלקית, ומשמעותו, 'חג השלמה', 'חידוש', או 'חסות'. נראה שהשם נטבע כהשפעה של תרבות החסידות, שבה נחגג חג השלמה. באופן כללי, השם יכול להתקשר להשלמה, שלמות, או אף לחסות, ולאחדות. בתקופת ימי הביניים, השם 'ורנה' נמצא בשימוש נדיר, אך עם זאת, הוא נחשב לשם יוצא דופן בקרב העם היהודי.

in_greek.name: Βέρνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βέρνα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό γράμμα Β και το όνομα Βερναίκος, το οποίο σημαίνει 'εμφάνιση' ή 'απαρχή'. Στο Βυζαντινό κράτος, το όνομα Βέρνα ήταν σπάνιο, αλλά είχε σημασία στην Κρητική γλώσσα, όπου αναφέρεται σε ένα έπος. Στην Κριτική γλώσσα, το όνομα Βέρνα συνδέεται με τα ονόματα Βερνέσος και Βερνίκα, τα οποία σημαίνουν 'εμφάνιση' και 'απαρχή' αντίστοιχα.

in_latin.name: Verna
in_latin.meaning: Nomina Christiana, origo Italiensis, festus, novitas
in_latin.long_meaning: Verna est nomen femininum, quod originem habet ex lingua Italica, et significat 'festus', 'novitas', aut 'protegor'. Apparet, quod nomen hoc natus est ex influxu culturae Christianae, in qua festus celebratur. Generaliter, nomen hoc potest referri ad festum, integritatem, aut protegorem, et unitatem. In tempore medievali, nomen 'Verna' apparuit raro, sed tamen reputatur nomen eximium in populo Christiano.

in_english.name: Verna
in_english.meaning: Christian name, Italian origin, festival, novelty, protector
in_english.long_meaning: Verna is a Christian feminine given name, originating from Italy, meaning 'festival', 'novelty', or 'protector'. It appears that the name was born from the influence of Christian culture, in which the festival is celebrated. Generally, the name can be associated with 'festival', 'integrity', or 'protector', and 'unity'. In medieval times, the name 'Verna' appeared rarely, but is nevertheless considered an exceptional name in Christian culture. In Christian tradition, Verna may symbolize new beginnings, renewal, or spiritual protection.

The name notes the strong marital bond, as it is often associated with a traditional yet enduring matrimonial vow.

The name resonates with individuals who deeply seek truth in their spiritual lives or practice Christianity with a solid commitment to the authentic teachings of the faith. This name invokes strong associations with integrity, sincerity, and a profound connection to God. The unwavering faith of individuals named Verna inspires others to seek deeper meaning, understanding, and inner growth.
